title: Straylight Control Plane audit record (v1)
description: Codex's independent audit verdict, bound to an exact head SHA. CANONICAL LOCATION: a comment on the LANE ISSUE (the only stream the reducer/watchdog reconstruct from). It is never committed into the audited PR, because committing it changes the audited target (lesson of PR #116, ADR-050 §5.3). Executable validator: .straylight/lib/validate.mjs#validateAuditRecord.

head_branch.description: Must equal the lane's established working_branch (set by the initial coordinator packet) or the reducer refuses (audit-head-branch-mismatch).

audited_head_sha.description: The exact head SHA the verdict binds to. An ACCEPT is valid only while the PR head still equals this SHA; any head move invalidates it.

complete_diff_reviewed.description: Must be true: confirmation the complete base-to-head diff was reviewed, not a sample.

changed_files.description: Changed-file list as reviewed by the auditor. Informational content of the audit record — no separate per-file verification is performed on it; its integrity is guaranteed by the audit record's own content digest (refs.audit_digest on the completion event, recomputed on every replay).

audit_committed_in_pr.description: AUDITOR ATTESTATION (self-reported), not a mechanical fact: the auditor asserts the audit was not committed into the audited PR (PR #116 lesson). The validator rejects a true attestation; the exact-SHA / live-head binding in the reducer is what mechanically defeats an audit that actually committed into the PR (its head SHA would no longer match). See ADR-050 §5.3.

retryable.description: REQUIRED (boolean) for CANNOT_AUDIT and forbidden on every other verdict: true routes back to ready-for-codex within the retry budget (next_actor auditor); false, or an exhausted budget, routes to blocked (next_actor operator). The executable validator refuses a CANNOT_AUDIT without it and any other verdict with it.

audit_comment_ref.description: URL or id of the lane-issue comment carrying this audit record (the canonical location).

next_actor.description: Must agree with the verdict routing the reducer performs: ACCEPT→system (eligibility-pending awaits the system's durable live-metadata confirmation), PATCH→coordinator, REJECT→operator, CANNOT_AUDIT→auditor when retryable else operator. The executable validator refuses a contradiction.
